newsitem.title: FRANCE: Canal Plus/Nethold deal seen final in a few weeks.
newsitem.headline: Canal Plus/Nethold deal seen final in a few weeks.

text.p: The definitive merger agreement between French pay television group Canal Plus and Dutch-based Nethold is likely to be signed in the next few weeks, a Nethold spokesman told Reuters.
"The initial deal was only a few pages long. The final deal should be signed in a few weeks' time," he said. He could not indicate where the group would be based nor what its name would be.
The merger of the two companies, announced early September, will create the biggest European pay television group with 8.5 million subscribers.
